original_criteria.title: Source-driven same-candidate reissue and acquisition
original_criteria.required_signal: An admitted substantive source-content/acquisition change reissues the same candidate through current WMR/N5/history; ID/order/write-time-only changes do not reissue; requirement and acquisition remain separate.

property_and_proxy.property: A source owner admits an actual active source/acquisition change; the change is recomputed as relevant to the exact same candidate's selected operator/target slots/outcome and valid-time basis; only then the same candidate is re-entered through N5/N8 and a fresh history readback records the resulting source/context lineage. Identity/time-only changes with unchanged source content do not trigger reissue.
property_and_proxy.current_measured_projection: N4CandidateScenarioSourceRecordV3 recomputes stable_subject_ref + Trinity problem/policy/model + selected intervention + profile selection semantics into semantic_identity_hash (excluding N5 baseline). It binds candidate_occurrence_hash to the atom content hash and nests an exact V2 selected source view. An origin V3 must share stable subject, semantic identity, profile selection and candidate ID, but differ in both candidate occurrence hash and full world_model_record_hash. CAS bytes, manifest profile, context, model, NCM, tenant/job/run and origin chain are resolved/recomputed.
property_and_proxy.proxy_divergence: world_model_record_hash is a full-record content digest, not a selected candidate relevance projection. A changed slot unrelated to the selected candidate changes the full WMR hash; the V3 reissue predicate does not compare the changed slot with the candidate's selected operator/target/outcome. The atom's world-model reference can also change its occurrence hash. No current source-owner event says the changed WMR content is an admitted acquisition relevant to this candidate.
property_and_proxy.identity_time_counterfeit_control: The current WMR content-hash implementation strips world_model_record_id, created_at, producer_ref and authority_status. A direct typed control changed only ID/time and kept the WMR content hash; adding an unselected policy slot changed the full-record hash. Probe receipt: LOCAL/v1-v2/v3-wmr-hash-probe.log@sha256:a8e530e7809ac75684728c23984517ff1d36077b59d519f43108a34aff1983e1. Thus ID/time alone is not a source-content change, while an unrelated content field is sufficient to change the measured hash.

prototype_and_falsifiers.current_prototype: N4CandidateScenarioSourceRecordV3 provides a strict optional same-candidate semantic identity/origin-chain verifier. The configured ordinary POST test proves real N4 source→N5 with exact profile/context and a time-drift stop. The rerun served acquisition integration proves local active-overlay owner admission and a new N5 output for the same DesignProblem using the acquired target-slot observation. The actual receipt links candidate_cgf_shadow while the new source candidate is candidate_123b27397979d0b7; the source origin is null and the fixture does not establish cross-cycle candidate equality. A fresh run GET projection has now been added to resolve the persisted receipts and source ref, preserve that mismatch, and return no history if the selected reentry bytes are corrupt; those new assertions were not rerun in this author turn. These are bounded mechanism witnesses, not V3 closure.
prototype_and_falsifiers.extension_migration_option: If G selects option B, preserve V1-V3 source artifacts and their replay semantics unchanged. Introduce a versioned current source/reentry companion carrying the owner-issued acquisition receipt, exact before/after selected source refs, candidate relevance binding and owner valid/transaction times; current consumers must resolve/recompute those fields and expose the complete chain through fresh run history. Historical V1-V3 remain readable but cannot acquire the new admitted-relevance status by migration or defaulting. No source/schema contract is selected by this packet.
prototype_and_falsifiers.counterfeit_falsifier: With WMR markers unchanged, change only world_model_record_id and created_at: content hash stays equal, so a content-change admission must not claim new evidence. Change only an unselected WMR slot: full content hash changes, but candidate-relevance is unmeasured. The local active-acquisition witness changes the selected government.balance input and N5 result, but a receipt carrying the prior candidate plus a new cycle marker is insufficient unless the consumer recomputes same-candidate equality and resolves the V3 origin chain. A consumer that admits reissue on full WMR hash inequality or adjacent receipt fields alone is a P38 proxy pass.
prototype_and_falsifiers.source_change_positive_required: The local Data Forge path supplies a controlled active-overlay positive for N5 recomputation, and the new run-details history consumer resolves the persisted route/reentry receipts plus selected N4/N5 source refs. A V3 positive still needs the same-subject before/after source pair through V3 origin_source_ref, exact equality of prior and new selected candidate, and changed occurrence/WMR content bound to the selected target/operator/outcome. The current fixture instead exposes differing candidate ids and null origin. For an external claim, source-owner admission/currentness and valid/transaction times must also be present; current L01/L02 evidence is locator/metadata only.

minimum_genuine_inputs.admission_owner: The existing source/selection owner that identifies the actually active artifact and signs or otherwise provides recomputable custody, tenant/purpose scope, validity/transaction times, source epoch, and revocation/currentness. An artifact ID, content hash, version counter, cache key or fixture response is not that owner.
minimum_genuine_inputs.candidate_relevance_projection: A recomputable projection from the selected candidate's exact target/operator/outcome/unit to the source fields that can alter its N5/N8 inputs, with explicit evidence of what changed and why the same semantic candidate is affected.
minimum_genuine_inputs.input_packet: Private L01/L02 minimal locator plus source bytes or owner-resolved immutable ref; before/after content, active-profile/selection binding, exact subject/unit/outcome and valid/transaction time, and issuer/consumer pairing. The inspected L01/L02 packet is metadata/locator only; authentic pairing remains UNRUN, not proof of absence.
minimum_genuine_inputs.history_consumer: The run-details projection resolves route/reentry receipts and selected N4/N5 source refs, then exposes the observed candidate mismatch and nullable origin. It does not admit a relevance predicate or same-candidate status; those remain a G-selected, source-owner-backed extension.

status_authority_time_provenance.candidate_band: Candidate re-computation may be scheduled under explicit unknown/limited status; it cannot become evidence-grounded or authority-grade from artifact lineage alone.
status_authority_time_provenance.authority_band: Any confidence forwarding, protected admission or publication remains withheld until the exact qualified K_ref/Credal and source-owner currentness predicates are admitted.
status_authority_time_provenance.time: WMR content hash intentionally excludes ID/created_at/producer/status; relevant valid time and transaction time must be carried by the source owner, not inferred from artifact occurrence.
status_authority_time_provenance.provenance: A synthetic/new fixture identity is controlled mechanism evidence only; original recorded source bytes are unchanged and external custody is not inferred.

pattern_pass.existing_anti_pattern: Equating CAS/WMR hash inequality, source-epoch counts, identity, or time metadata with an admitted source change relevant to the selected candidate.
pattern_pass.p40_bucket: Same N4 source/history lineage class one level deeper: the public reader now links persisted route/reentry receipts and source refs, while the controlled result still has a different new candidate id and null origin; candidate relevance is unmeasured. Retain the residual with the identity/time-only and unrelated-content falsifiers; do not treat the history projection or an adjacent receipt as a same-candidate/relevance binding.
